learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One hibiscus bloom in a slight side view with gracefully overlapping petals, extended staminal column, curved branch and two broad serrated leaves.
Complete subject inside the central 76% of the square with 12% clear margins on all four sides. Pure dark contours and open white interiors, no texture, shading or wash. The projecting flower column has only THREE terminal circles, with no tiny stamens or dense seeds.
